failure_policy.model_input_limitation: A model may use a documented, identity-checked subset only when an immutable scope record specifies its relation-table hash, population counts, affected model identities, and excluded queries/relations. The same scoring, cross-fitting, aggregation, and bootstrap rules apply; this is not a second RefSet or scoring method.

held_out_credit.credit: 1 if delta>0; 0 if delta=0; -1 if delta<0

outputs.interval: F 95% interval from the F bootstrap distribution

release_note: Public F-only scoring interface; the biological relationship, nested cross-fit design and RefSet are unchanged.
representation_input: One frozen finite residue-addressable vector per required residue ID. Finite zero vectors remain valid.

training.lambda_selection: Maximize the complete formal hierarchy F on inner out-of-fold queries pooled across the outer-training population; exact ties select the largest lambda.
training.sample_weight: equal dependency-cluster mass; equal structure mass within cluster; equal anchor mass within structure; equal query mass within anchor; positive row gets half query mass and K negatives share the other half; final training-row weights normalized to mean 1
training.standardization: training-fold weighted mean and weighted population SD for each pair-feature coordinate; zero SD maps to scale 1; never fit on held-out data

uncertainty.interpretation: conditional on the frozen RefSet, split and fitted OOF readouts; does not include readout retraining variance
uncertainty.method: ordinary with-replacement cluster bootstrap over frozen OOF cluster scores
